# arrowlane-cpp

C++23 implementation of the arrowlane wire frame, the Arrow schema flatbuffer
codec, and four lanes: json, ipc, ipc-zstd, shm.

Reads and writes frame format version 1. Interoperates with the Python package
arrowlane 0.3.1 in both directions. No Arrow C++ dependency. No Python at
runtime.

Start here:

- README.md: status, build, test, supported types
- docs/ai/api.md: the C++ surface, the C ABI, the command line, measured numbers
- docs/ai/manifest.json: the capability manifest, generated from describe
- docs/decisions.md: the visibility, version and CRC decisions
- docs/feature-matrix.md: which language features this toolchain has
- AGENTS.md: commands and boundaries for automated work
